I can see the RTCM3 handling. The issue is in the `RTCM3_RECOGNIZED` case. When `data_len` is large (up to 0x3FF = 1023), the code reads `lexer->inbufptr[idx + data_len + 1]`, `lexer->inbufptr[idx + data_len + 2]`, and `lexer->inbufptr[idx + data_len + 3]` in the error logging path. But more importantly, `crc24q_check(&lexer->inbuffer[idx], data_len + 6)` reads `data_len + 6` bytes from the buffer. If `data_len` is large and the buffer is small, this reads past the end of the stack buffer.
